verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a card-issuing platform. The evidence only shows machine-readable transaction data: a transactions API that retrieves transactions by card, merchant, or account holder, plus real-time event webhooks. Nothing in the pack documents settlement files or reconciliation reports. Missing for 10: daily settlement/reconciliation files, report APIs covering interchange, fees and network adjustments, documentation of automated finance-stack consumption, and independent corroboration.
